args.body:
File: README.md

Update the 'Running locally' section of README.md to mention setting S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 when using MinIO as the S3-compatible store.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

README.md mentions MinIO as the quickest option for the S3-compatible store under 'Running locally', but doesn't mention setting S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000. Update README.md under 'Running locally' to mention setting S3_ENDPOINT for MinIO (and optionally bucket creation).
